##### Project general facts

Onda by Kasco is a contemporary residential development in Dubai that brings together modern architecture, coastal inspiration, and refined urban living. Designed as an elegant sanctuary within the city, the project offers a curated collection of studios, 1.5-, 2-, 2.5-, and 3-bedroom apartments, each thoughtfully crafted to reflect a seamless connection between sophisticated interiors and the calming rhythms of nature. The architecture and design language are inspired by the nearby waterfront, creating an atmosphere of tranquility and understated luxury in the heart of a dynamic urban environment.

Residents at Onda by Kasco enjoy an exceptional selection of lifestyle and wellness amenities designed to elevate everyday living. The development features an infinity pool, indoor and outdoor swimming pools, a fully equipped gym, luxurious spa facilities, steam rooms, a cold plunge room, and a dedicated yoga area focused on holistic well-being. Social and functional spaces include a wellness café, co-working areas, outdoor lounges, a running track, and family-friendly amenities such as a children’s pool. Together, these thoughtfully designed facilities create a balanced lifestyle centered around comfort, wellness, productivity, and relaxation.

The residences at Onda by Kasco are finished with modern high-quality materials that emphasize elegance, comfort, and functionality. Spacious layouts are complemented by contemporary detailing and large windows that enhance natural light throughout the interiors. Each apartment includes a fully equipped kitchen with integrated appliances, while the semi-furnished concept allows residents to personalize their living spaces while benefiting from a refined and move-in-ready environment. The project reflects Kasco’s vision of creating sophisticated homes that combine modern luxury with a serene residential experience.

##### Location description and benefits

Business Bay is one of Dubai’s most dynamic and fast-paced neighborhoods, known as the city's central business, commercial, and residential hub. Located just minutes from Downtown Dubai and the iconic Burj Khalifa, it offers a strategic location with seamless access to Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road. Business Bay is a prime destination for professionals, entrepreneurs, and investors looking to be at the heart of Dubai’s thriving economy, with a skyline defined by high-rise towers, luxury hotels, and modern office spaces.

Beyond its corporate appeal, Business Bay has evolved into a vibrant lifestyle destination. The area features a wide range of residential options, from upscale studios to spacious penthouses, many with stunning views of the Dubai Canal. Residents enjoy an urban lifestyle with access to fine dining, boutique cafes, waterfront promenades, gyms, and art spaces, all set against a backdrop of architectural elegance. The Dubai Water Canal also adds a touch of serenity, perfect for walks, boat rides, or simply enjoying the city lights by the water.

As one of the most well-connected and sought-after areas in Dubai, Business Bay continues to grow as a leading hub for luxury living and commercial innovation. Whether you're working, living, or investing, it offers the perfect blend of modern convenience, cosmopolitan energy, and high-end urban living — all in one prime location.
